Name: Elioenai, Son of Neariah
Summary: Son of Neariah and father of Hodaiah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Dalaiah, and Anani.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:23: Son of Neariah and father of Hodaiah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Dalaiah, and Anani.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Elioenai stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
